hero.subtitle: I'm a software developer who believes true design goes deeper than the surface. Intuitive UI/UX on the outside, robust architecture on the inside—built to last.

buildWebsite.title: Build a Website
buildWebsite.desc: A custom, modern website tailored to your vision — fast, responsive, and built to last.

buildApp.title: Build an App
buildApp.desc: Turn your idea into a real mobile or web application — from concept to launch and beyond.

minecraft.title: Minecraft Project?
minecraft.desc: A custom plugin, datapack, or mod — simple items to complex combat systems for your server or friends.

buildGame.title: Build a Game
buildGame.desc: Had a game idea you never got to play? Let's bring it to life — from concept to playable reality.

hardrevival.desc: The complete HardRevival Minecraft project — I set up the entire server from scratch and programmed the custom mod behind the brutal PvP hardcore experience. The landing page adds a dark glitch aesthetic, live leaderboards, per-player statistics and a real-time Discord community counter.
features: Full server setup — infrastructure, configuration and deployment
Custom-programmed mod: Life Saver, death structures and revival rituals
Landing page with live leaderboard and Discord online counter

atelier.desc: Website for Atelier Dufour, an art studio in Biel/Bienne. A warm, gallery-like site with a full-screen image slideshow, creative workshops for kids and young people, and an integral clay offer (INTON®).
features: Full-screen slideshow gallery of the studio's work
Workshop pages — chocolate casting, papier-mâché, screen printing, open studio
Integral clay sessions with times, prices and contact
